headerDisplay: Local control of Samsung D-series and later soundbars over the IP Control interface on port 1516. No SmartThings account or internet connection required.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name shown in the Home app.

host.title: IP Address
host.description: Give the soundbar a DHCP reservation so this does not change.

model.title: Model
model.description: Cosmetic only. Shown in the accessory details.

maxVolume.title: Maximum Volume
maxVolume.description: The top of the soundbar's own volume scale, or a lower ceiling if you want the HomeKit slider spread across only the range you actually use. The HW-Q930D tops out at 100. Setting this lower than the hardware maximum acts as a volume limit.

inputs.title: Inputs to expose
inputs.description: Leave unset to expose all of them.
